title: Stable self-similar blowup for a supercritical defocusing Schrödinger equation on the torus
summary: We prove stable self-similar finite-time blowup for a supercritical defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the twelve-dimensional torus. For a sufficiently large odd power, the blowup initial data contain a nonempty open set in a high Sobolev space. As a consequence, Gaussian Fourier initial data of arbitrarily high Sobolev regularity can have positive probability of finite-time blowup.
